user.title: Configure One Bridge
user.description: Connect this Home Assistant installation to a ChatGPT GPT Action. This public HACS build is target-only.

data_description.role: Use target for normal installations. Source requires a local release policy and is intended for the primary release source only.
data_description.public_base_url: Public HTTPS origin for this Home Assistant instance, without path, query, or fragment.
data_description.require_admin: Only allow Home Assistant administrators to use the bridge.
data_description.require_owner: Additionally require the Home Assistant owner account.

permissions.title: Choose GPT access
permissions.description: Choose a preset for what this GPT may access. Home control is the recommended starting point. Custom lets you choose individual server-enforced capabilities.

capabilities.title: Choose allowed capabilities
capabilities.description: Only selected capabilities are exposed in the generated operation catalog and GPT Action schema. Status/catalog access is always retained. Apply is added automatically when a selected capability can prepare changes.

credentials.title: Complete GPT Action setup
credentials.description:
Copy the OAuth values and GPT setup information below. The generated client secret is shown only now. Complete this screen to activate One Bridge, then configure the GPT Action. The GPT editor will provide the callback URL; add it afterwards in One Bridge Options before OAuth sign-in.

**OAuth**

Client ID: `{client_id}`

Client Secret: `{client_secret}`

Authorization URL: `{authorization_url}`

Token URL: `{token_url}`

Scope: `{scope}`

Callback: `{callback_url}`

**GPT Action schema**

Schema URL: `{schema_url}`

**Text instructions**

Instructions URL: `{instructions_url}`

**Copy-friendly setup**

Setup page: `{setup_url}`

Privacy Policy URL: `{privacy_url}`

Preset: `{permission_preset}`

Capabilities: `{capabilities}`

```text
{gpt_instructions}
```

data.confirm: I have copied the OAuth and GPT setup information

error.invalid_configuration: The URLs or role are not valid.
error.invalid_permissions: The selected access preset or capabilities are not valid for this role.
error.secret_not_confirmed: Copy the OAuth and GPT setup information and confirm before continuing.

abort.missing_pending_configuration: The temporary One Bridge configuration was lost. Start setup again.

init.title: One Bridge setup and access
init.description: Update callback, GPT access and security settings. If only the callback URL changes, it is saved directly when you submit this screen. Other changes are staged and reviewed on the next screen before activation. Rotate the OAuth client secret only when you are ready to replace it in the GPT Action.

data.rotate_client_secret: Generate a new OAuth client secret

data_description.callback_url: Paste the callback URL shown by the GPT Action editor. A callback-only change is saved directly when you submit this screen. Leave blank until the editor provides one.
data_description.permission_preset: Controls which capabilities and operations the GPT may use.
data_description.require_admin: Only allow Home Assistant administrators to use the bridge.
data_description.require_owner: Additionally require the Home Assistant owner account.
data_description.read_only_lockdown: Block prepare/apply mutations while keeping allowed read operations available.
data_description.rotate_client_secret: Generates a replacement secret and shows it once on the next screen. The existing secret stays active unless you confirm the staged settings.
data_description.internal_ws_url: Optional loopback WebSocket endpoint ending in /api/websocket; leave blank for Auto.
data_description.internal_ws_verify_ssl: Verify TLS certificates when the internal WebSocket uses wss://.

capabilities.title: Choose allowed capabilities
capabilities.description: Choose the exact server-enforced capabilities for this GPT. Status/catalog access is always retained, and apply is added automatically when required by selected write capabilities.

setup.title: Updated GPT setup
setup.description:
These settings are staged and are not active yet. Review the values below. If a new client secret is shown, copy it before confirming; the old secret remains active if you leave this flow. Confirming activates the staged settings. If permissions changed, re-import the stable Schema URL so the GPT editor receives the new operation list.

**OAuth**

Client ID: `{client_id}`

Client Secret: `{client_secret}`

Authorization URL: `{authorization_url}`

Token URL: `{token_url}`

Scope: `{scope}`

Callback URL: `{callback_url}`

**GPT Action schema**

Schema URL: `{schema_url}`

**Text instructions**

Instructions URL: `{instructions_url}`

**Copy-friendly setup**

Setup page: `{setup_url}`

Privacy Policy URL: `{privacy_url}`

Preset: `{permission_preset}`

Capabilities: `{capabilities}`

```text
{gpt_instructions}
```
